id.instruksi: Baca keadaannya, lalu sentuh tugas rangka yang sedang terjadi.
id.p-r1: Tengkorak menutup otak rapat-rapat seperti helm. Apa tugas rangka di sini?
id.p-r2: Tulang rusuk mengelilingi jantung dan paru-paru. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r3: Tanpa tulang belakang, badan tidak bisa duduk tegak. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r4: Tulang kaki menahan berat badan saat kita berdiri lama. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r5: Otot menarik tulang paha saat kita menendang bola. Apa tugas tulang di sini?
id.p-r6: Sendi lutut membuat kaki bisa ditekuk saat naik tangga. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r7: Kerangka di museum masih menunjukkan wujud dinosaurus walau dagingnya sudah lama hilang. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r8: Ruas-ruas tulang belakang membungkus saraf penting seperti terowongan. Apa tugasnya di sini?
id.p-r9: Tempurung lutut menutupi bagian depan sendi lutut agar tidak mudah cedera. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r10: Tulang panggul menahan berat tubuh bagian atas saat kita duduk. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r11: Sendi bahu membuat lengan bisa diputar saat berenang. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-r12: Otot menarik tulang rahang naik-turun saat kita mengunyah. Apa tugas tulang di sini?
id.p-r13: Rangka membuat wujud tubuh kita khas manusia: bahu lebar, lengan dan kaki panjang. Apa tugasnya?

en.instruksi: Read the situation, then touch the job the skeleton is doing.
en.p-r1: The skull covers the brain tightly like a helmet. What job is the skeleton doing?
en.p-r2: The rib cage surrounds the heart and lungs. What is its job?
en.p-r3: Without a spine, the body could not sit up straight. What is its job?
en.p-r4: Leg bones hold up the body's weight when we stand for a long time. What is their job?
en.p-r5: Muscles pull the thigh bone when we kick a ball. What job is the bone doing?
en.p-r6: The knee joint lets the leg bend when we climb stairs. What is its job?
en.p-r7: A museum skeleton still shows the dinosaur's form long after the flesh is gone. What is its job?
en.p-r8: The bones of the spine wrap around important nerves like a tunnel. What is their job here?
en.p-r9: The kneecap covers the front of the knee joint so it is not easily hurt. What is its job?
en.p-r10: The hip bones hold up the weight of the upper body when we sit. What is their job?
en.p-r11: The shoulder joint lets the arm turn round while swimming. What is its job?
en.p-r12: Muscles pull the jaw bone up and down while we chew. What is the bone's job here?
en.p-r13: The skeleton gives our body its human outline: wide shoulders, long arms and legs. What is its job?
